values.note: Online (FareHarbor) until 3 hours before arrival, then by phone. Bookings for the year open the first business day of January; early requests by form December 1-15. The 14-night limit applies Memorial Day-Labor Day (14 days in any 3 weeks), with 40 days a year.

booking.source: https://www.co.sauk.wi.us/sites/default/files/fileattachments/parks_and_recreation/page/2024/policies_rules_-_white_mound_county_park_campground_112625.pdf + https://fareharbor.com/api/v1/companies/whitemound/items/ (cutoff 3 h before start, then call to book), read 2026-11-17

values.note: Electric sites $25, non-electric $20. Each booking carries a $5 fee (FareHarbor, read 2026-10-11). A daily vehicle pass ($5) or annual pass ($25 one vehicle, $40 two) is needed.

fees.source: https://www.co.sauk.wi.us/sites/default/files/fileattachments/parks_and_recreation/page/2024/2025_white_mound_county_park_brochure.pdf (FEES: $25 electric, $20 nonelectric, daily pass $5, annual $25/$40), read 2026-11-17; reservation fee from https://fareharbor.com/embeds/book/whitemound/items/ read 2026-10-11

note: Sauk County park around 104-acre White Mound Lake; the campground sits in the woods about 250 m west of the lake. Sites run 28-58 ft; 48E is the only one with a water hook-up. The 7-site horse campground has its own road to the north and is for campers bringing horses. --Claude
summary: Sauk County pages, brochure + campground maps, Policies & Rules (11/2025) and FareHarbor item list read. 46 sites (37 electric, 20/30/50A), 4 pull-throughs, 28-58 ft; water hook-up at 48E only; showers, laundry, vault toilets, dump; $25/$20 + $5 booking fee + $5 daily pass; Apr 1-Nov 30; FareHarbor + phone. Horse campground is a separate area - keep. Not waterfront confirmed. Pin moves ~590 m from the beach/office lot to the campground.
flags: PIN: stored 43.3551,-90.0958 is the beach/office parking lot (#1 on the park map). Recommend 43.3604,-90.0961 (centre of the family campground loops, #2), ~590 m north.

HORSE: the 7-site horse campground (H1-H7) is a SEPARATE area with its own road and corrals north of the family campground (brochure map #3; 'Horse campsites are available only to those who bring their own horses'). No horse sites in the general loops - keep.
WATERFRONT: 'not waterfront' confirmed - the campground is in woods ~250 m west of White Mound Lake (imagery at 43.3604,-90.0961).
HOOKUPS: water=true rests on ONE site (48E, 'the only campsite with a water hook-up', a public bookable 45-ft 20/30/50A back-in). Reviewer may prefer water unrecorded/false given only 1 of 46 sites.

MIN STAY: the stored fees note said 'Online bookings start at 2 nights' (FareHarbor capture 2026-10-11). Today's FareHarbor item offers 1-7 night options and the county policies publish no minimum, so no min_stay written; the 2027 calendar is not open to check.
SEASON: family campground 'typically open April 1 to November 30' (stored, now manual); horse campground May 15-Oct 31; rustic hike-in sites April 1-Labor Day. 'No seasonal campsites are available.'

PHONE: 608-355-4800 confirmed. WEBSITE https://www.co.sauk.wi.us/parksandrecreation/camping-reservations live - keep; optionally add https://fareharbor.com/embeds/book/whitemound/ (booking.url carries it).
